children: Shares of Bank7 rose after the company said it was named the successful bidder in an auction to acquire a controlling stake in Century Financial Services Corp.
Shares were up 8.1% to $56.70 on Friday. The stock has risen 38% this year.

Bank7 said it will pay $91 million for a roughly 71% stake in the holding company for Century Bank. That includes a break-up credit of around $2 million, leading to a net cash purchase price of about $89 million, the company said.
The shares are being sold through a court-supervised sale process, the company said, adding that the deal is still subject to bank regulatory approvals.
The deal is expected to close in the fourth quarter.
